name: Nazia Ahmed
bio:
Nazia is currently completing a Master of Design at the University of Auckland and intends to pursue User Experience Design. Prior to this, Nazia completed a Bachelor of Health Sciences and a Postgraduate Diploma in Public Health.

Nazia is passionate about people and in finding better ways to help, which she has developed through her background in Public Health, and experience in developing resources for patients within the District Health Boards.

In her spare time, Nazia loves to go on food adventures and binge watch Netflix.
